audit_method: Same-agent exact comparison against the frozen source, controlling axiom and rule displays, proof-local premises and conclusions, language-tag branches, and semantic counterexamples within that revision. No claim about current upstream master is made.

corrections.finding: The definition says the set of PAx of axioms, with an extra preposition that obscures PAx as the set being defined.
corrections.handling: Stated directly that PAx is the set of axioms and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The following display enumerates precisely the members of PAx.

corrections.finding: Both item commands in the quantifier-rule definition occur outside any list environment.
corrections.handling: Wrapped the two rules in an enumerate environment and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: LaTeX item commands require a list environment, and the two parallel rules form one ordered list.

corrections.finding: Both quantifier rules exclude the eigenconstant from Gamma and B but fail to exclude it from A(x).
corrections.handling: Added exclusion from A(x) to both rules and added an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.removed: a absent only from Gamma and B
mathematical_delta.added: a absent from Gamma, B, and A(x)

corrections.controlling_evidence: Without the added condition, taking A(x) as x=a in a structure with more than one object licenses an invalid universalization; the later soundness proof also invokes absence from B(x).

corrections.finding: The proof says every replacement occurrence is justified by the same rule as A_k, although A_k may instead be an axiom or a member of Gamma.
corrections.handling: Used the broader and exact phrase same reason and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The immediately preceding definition gives three possible reasons for A_k: axiom, hypothesis, or inference rule.

corrections.finding: The first listed derivability fact lacks the closing parenthesis for its outer consequent.
corrections.handling: Restored the final closing parenthesis and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The intended schema composes A implies B with B implies C to obtain A implies C, and the displayed parentheses otherwise remain unbalanced.

corrections.finding: A displayed propositional theorem used in the quantified deduction proof lacks its final closing parenthesis.
corrections.handling: Restored the final closing parenthesis and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The theorem curries the conjunction antecedent, requiring two closing parentheses after the quantified consequent.

corrections.finding: The proof concludes Gamma proves B although the theorem and immediately preceding derivation require Gamma proves A implies B.
corrections.handling: Restored A implies B as the conclusion and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The theorem statement is the one-way deduction theorem, B is identified with C implies forall x D(x), and the preceding line proves A implies that formula.

corrections.finding: The proof cites the left-conjunction axiom for both conjunction projections.
corrections.handling: Cited the right-conjunction axiom for the second projection and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The axiom display labels the A projection ax:land1 and the B projection ax:land2.

corrections.finding: The proof attributes not-A implies A implies false to ax:lnot1, although it is the B=false instance of ax:lnot2.
corrections.handling: Cited ax:lnot2 and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The axiom display defines ax:lnot2 as not A implies A implies B.

corrections.finding: The rule name modus ponens is misspelled as modus ponsens.
corrections.handling: Used the established Gujarati form of modus ponens and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The rule is defined and abbreviated as modus ponens in the same chapter.

corrections.finding: The proof switches from the configured language symbol ltrue to a raw top symbol.
corrections.handling: Used ltrue consistently and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The preceding and following formulas and ax:ltrue all use the language macro ltrue.

corrections.finding: The final step from ltrue implies forall x A(x) to forall x A(x) is attributed to the deduction theorem again.
corrections.handling: Used the ltrue axiom and modus ponens as the actual final inference and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The premise ltrue is an axiom and modus ponens applied to it and the displayed implication yields the claimed result.

corrections.finding: Three formula-variable occurrences omit the source authoring marker before B.
corrections.handling: Restored the marker in all three occurrences and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: Every neighbouring occurrence in the rule, substitution, satisfaction and extensionality argument uses the marked formula variable B.

corrections.finding: The proposition covers every axiom, but the first-order proof presents only q1 and leaves q2 and the propositional schemas unstated.
corrections.handling: Made explicit that q2 follows by the reverse substitution direction and that truth tables verify the propositional schemas, then added an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.added: q2 substitution direction and propositional truth-table cases

corrections.controlling_evidence: The chapter's axiom inventory consists of q1, q2 and the displayed propositional schemas.

corrections.finding: Two propositions are stated for arbitrary terms although the immediately governing identity axiom schemas are restricted to closed terms.
corrections.handling: Restricted both propositions to closed terms and added an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.removed: arbitrary terms t, t1 and t2
mathematical_delta.added: closed terms t, t1 and t2

corrections.controlling_evidence: The displayed identity axiom definition explicitly quantifies only over closed terms, and the supplied proofs instantiate those axioms directly.

corrections.finding: One repeated occurrence of B_i lacks the source authoring marker used by every other formula variable in the derivation.
corrections.handling: Restored the marker and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The displayed concatenated derivation and every preceding reference identify the same sequence members as marked formula variables B_i.

corrections.finding: The membership symbol is isolated in a separate math span from its left operand B, leaving an ill-formed mathematical fragment.
corrections.handling: Expressed B as a member of Gamma union {A} in one coherent statement and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The induction basis has exactly the two cases B belongs to Gamma union {A}, or B is an axiom.

corrections.finding: The shared FOL and propositional chapter calls every derivable propositional formula valid instead of using the corresponding term tautology.
corrections.handling: Selected validity for FOL and tautologicity for the propositional rendering, with an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.added: valid for FOL and tautological for PL

corrections.controlling_evidence: The same file already uses the identical FOL conditional distinction in the theorem proof and weak-soundness corollary.
